response.sql: WITH album_stats AS (SELECT AlbumId, COUNT(*) AS track_count, SUM(CASE WHEN Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN Bytes END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN Milliseconds END), 0) AS rate FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId), above_mean_albums AS (SELECT a.rate, a.track_count FROM album_stats a WHERE a.rate IS NOT NULL AND a.rate > (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM album_stats WHERE rate IS NOT NULL)) SELECT AVG(rate) AS average_rate, AVG(track_count) AS average_track_count, AVG(rate) - (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM album_stats WHERE rate IS NOT NULL) AS average_above_mean FROM above_mean_albums;
